title: Orange Lasagne with Pumpkin, Sweet Potato and Carrot
subtitle: with a carrot bechamel and goat's cheese
description: Layers of roasted pumpkin and sweet potato with soft goat's cheese and a creamy carrot bechamel, baked until golden and bubbling.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Thinly slice the pumpkin and sweet potato, boil and mash the carrots, and crush the garlic.
Arrange the pumpkin and sweet potato slices on the tray, drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, pepper and thyme.
Bake for 20 minutes until soft and golden.

Meanwhile make the bechamel. Melt the butter in a medium pot, add the flour and stir with a wooden spoon to form a paste. Pour in the milk, bring to the boil while stirring and cook over high heat for about 5 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir in the mashed carrot and season with salt, pepper, nutmeg, garlic and 3 tablespoons Parmesan. Set aside a quarter of the sauce for the top.

Spread a little bechamel on the bottom of a clean baking dish. Layer lasagne sheets, pumpkin and sweet potato, goat's cheese and bechamel, repeating, and finish with lasagne sheets. Pour the reserved bechamel over the top and sprinkle with Parmesan.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest for at least 5 minutes before cutting.
